collections.name: projects
collections.description: Full project lifecycle management — create projects with structured briefs, track ideas from private exploration to actionable artifacts, manage action items with dependency chains, record decisions, monitor comms channels, and generate status reports for stakeholders.
collections.author: agent-index

collections.name: strategy
collections.description: Build, evaluate, and evolve named strategies. Define canonical strategy references, configure information sources, run briefings that surface opportunities, and maintain a prioritized opportunity registry — private by default, shared per-person from your own member space (readers, collaborators, or org-wide read) with discovery via a pointer index.
collections.author: agent-index

collections.name: capture
collections.description: Personal capture and processing system. Quick-capture tasks, read-later content, ideas, and reference material into one unified registry. Organize with lists, tags, and contexts. Process your inbox and review what needs attention.
collections.author: agent-index

collections.name: email-triage
collections.description: Automated Gmail inbox triage with configurable categories, priority detection, iterative training, and summary delivery via Slack or chat.
collections.author: agent-index

collections.name: slack-triage
collections.description: Scan Slack for messages that need your response — unanswered DMs, @mentions, thread replies, and questions directed at you — and deliver a prioritized summary.
collections.author: agent-index

collections.name: bug-reports
collections.description: Bug reporting workflow — any member can submit and update their own bugs, org admins can review, triage, and forward selected reports to the agent-index log collection server.
collections.author: agent-index

collections.name: developer
collections.description: Unified development experience for building, evolving, and shipping agent-index collections — from first idea through marketplace submission.
collections.author: agent-index

collections.name: client-intelligence
collections.description: Primary repository of client-level knowledge. Admins author named templates that define mandatory and optional fields. Members create client instances from templates, can add their own extension fields, and manage per-instance View / Edit / Delete permissions enforced by Drive ACLs. A universally-visible visibility floor exposes client names to all collection members while gating data behind view permission. v1.0.0 ships 15 user-facing tasks plus a tutorial skill and an install-time bootstrap.
collections.author: agent-index
